reviews.x: I thought this product was fantastic other than the fact that it doesn’t dry on like a matte, it stays wet and it takes forever to dry. I was Pennywise for Halloween and for the price, itwas fantastic considering I had to put about 20 layers on and I still have lots to use.
I used this for a clown costume and barely used a dab on my finger.  It spread really well.  I did not go super white though.  I could use this for MANY more times.  It is plenty!!

I was hoping to get an opaque white full coverage paint. This took layer upon layer, was sticky, and no amount of setting powder kept it from caking in the creases of your face. Not sure how this product is best used, but it didn't work for me.

This face paint is not ideal for people who like to dress up as clowns . This paint does not dry, it looks shiny and forget trying to layer with shadows or other face paints . I used so much setting powder to try and matte it down but it made everything patchy . I use a brush and a beauty sponge to apply . The sponge was better for a true coverage but if you touched your face it was over . Not a good paint for hours of clown work .

reviews.t: Fair for price but very easy to come off
reviews.x: Pros. It did not irritate my sensitive skin. It is silky smooth and doesn't feel heavy  Cons. I used expensive primer and then used setting spray, setting powder, baby powder and even a little hair spray but it does not stay on well. If I accidentally tapped it lightly with my finger and brushed a hair away, it came off. Would not stick on eye lids for anything so just had unpainted lids. Had to reapply anywhere I accidentally tapped my face on the hour every hour. I wish it had a bit more stayi

We had a costume contest at work. I was a clown. Long story short I ended up being in costume, outside in Texas heat for over 2 hours. The makeup held up flawlessly. I was sweating and it didn't phase the makeup. Grade A quality and easy to apply. I would suggest purchasing a sponge to apply.

reviews.t: A little goes a long way
reviews.x: I bought a 2nd one of these because it is so small and my child had multiple performances, but the 2nd jar was totally unnecessary. We barely scraped the surface of this stuff to cover his entire face 4 separate times. GREAT STUFF, but far more than we needed :)

reviews.t: Goes on very easily, little goes a long way!
reviews.x: I ordered this for jack skellington halloween makeup...This product applies very easily, and a little goes a long way. If you want it to "set" so you can add other colors over it, "set" it with baby powder and cake the powder on well. Would definitely buy again.

Product arrived open and seems to have been used. Unfortunately I didn’t look until I needed to use it, and due to time had to scrape off the top layer. Works well, just very disappointed In product handling.
came with some stuff sitting on top, and not the brand I ordered it as but I didn't order for the brand so I guess that's not important to me. seems pretty good, with setting powder. no weird smell
Great texture and coverage, plus fast shipping, but some ingredient caused an allergic reaction that lasted 3 days! I suggest a patch test before using.
It was so transparent. Even after trying to put  more layers on it would just wipe off the current layer. Do not recommend!
it doesn’t dry and it’s greasy, it’ll come off on anything it touches & it’s transparent
You can probably get it darker by adding more but was great for the porcelain doll look
Worked well and sealed enough I could probably use next year!
GREAT coverage. Washes off easily. Not itchy, great makeup.
Extremely hard to remove from your skin!

For the price it’s really good white makeup. You do need at least two layers. I waited 10 minutes between layers and applied with a sponge. Make sure you load your product on the sponge because it does absorb it. It doesn’t dry matte but that’s an easy fix with powder. And it doesn’t feel greasy like the Halloween kit makeup. And super easy to remove with makeup wipes. Plus the tub is huge so you can do your makeup for like a week straight if you had to

[[VIDEOID:e9dc6137d97604f68f79dbbd342a6e2d]] I love this product!  I needed it for a Halloween costume. A little goes a long way. I definitely recommend it. I used it on my face along with a white translucent powder to set it and it worked well. I even use this with my everyday makeup when I want a white eyeshadow look to stand out. I like to use it under a white Morphe eyeshadow and it stays with no creasing. 👍🏼

Amazing! I wasn't really sure if this is what I wanted because I didn't want it to be stark white, but I decided to try it and it was perfect! I will say that it stays kinda tacky so you might want to get a setting powder of you don't have one! I used a setting spray and it stayed on for hours! Also it really does come off super easily, just a wipe or two with warm water got it right off!

I got this for my daughter that is really into mimes. We tried to do her face with this paint. It's so greasy when it's on that you can't get any other colors on top without smearing. So if you just want a greasy white face, this is for you. Really disappointed.

This thing is greasy and gives absolutely no coverage. You’ll just get some kind of shade. That’s it! And it will leave stains everywhere. As soon as you will touch something with your face or hand wearing this paste it will get dirty and greasy.

Great for costumes. I covered my whole face and part of my neck and it looks like it had been used to paint a nut! This will last for a long time! Wasn't expecting that! It just took me two quick washes to remove it.
It smears. It’s like putting on a face mask when you’re washing your face. It doesn’t dry. It just says on top of your face. The only way I reduced the amount of stickiness, was putting on powder
I bought this to paint our face. I went based on the reviews that was the reason why I bought it. But be ready to stain everything and I mean everything :( sadly it doesn’t stay on.

claims.text: Many reviewers say a little goes a long way and the product lasts for many uses.
A common complaint is that it stays wet, greasy, or shiny and does not dry down to a matte finish.
Several reviewers find it too transparent and needing many layers for full coverage.
Some reviewers report it comes off easily or transfers onto things it touches, even with setting products.
A few reviewers mention receiving a used, dirty, or different-brand product.
